home.introTitle: An architecture and interior practice, led by Ar. Jeanne Joseph.
home.introText: The Cornerstone Architect shapes homes from the first line of the plan to the final finishing touch. Every project begins with how you live — the light you wake to, the rooms you gather in, the corners you retreat to — and is built outward from there.

introImage.alt: Hands arranging tile, stone, timber and fabric samples on a floor plan

philosophy.title: Space
philosophy.text: Proportion, light and the way you move through a home are resolved first. A well-planned room needs very little to feel generous.

philosophy.title: Material
philosophy.text: Natural textures and honest finishes, chosen for how they feel and how they age, not only for how they photograph.

philosophy.title: Function
philosophy.text: Storage, routine and everyday use are drawn in early, so the home works as quietly as it looks.

philosophy.title: Sensibility
philosophy.text: Restraint over excess. Each element earns its place — the personality lives in the details.

home.storyText:

about.approach:
Architecture and interiors are not separate stages here. The same eye that resolves the plan carries through to the materials, the lighting and, finally, the furniture and objects that make a room lived-in.

We take the time to understand your space, your lifestyle and your personal taste before bringing the details together — so that what is built feels cohesive, warm and personal.

values.title: You first
values.text: Design begins with your lifestyle, your needs and how you live — not with a style.

values.title: Thoughtful selection
values.text: Every material, finish and piece is chosen with purpose.

values.title: Cohesive storytelling
values.text: A home should have flow, function and feeling, from room to room.

values.title: Relationship-driven
values.text: Guidance that helps you make confident decisions throughout the process.

finishing.heroText: Interior finishing & curation services. A signature service from The Cornerstone Architect.
finishing.whatWeDo:
A beautiful home is more than its fixed interiors. It is the furniture, lighting, textures, colours and personal details that bring a space together.

We curate these finishing elements around your existing interiors — from furniture and rugs to lighting, fabrics, art and décor, creating a home that feels cohesive, warm and personal.

Through personalised mood boards, thoughtful product research and guided showroom visits, we make the process of choosing the right pieces simple, enjoyable and uniquely yours.
